proposed_comments.title: Centralize eraser state cleanup
proposed_comments.body:
### Centralize eraser state cleanup

**Severity:** `critical`

Centralize eraser disengagement for every transition that leaves drawing or changes the drawing state. The cleanup must restore cursor clipping, re-enable Sticky Keys, clear the engaged state, restore the transient cursor area before changing the mode, and re-establish the normal drawing constraint when drawing continues. Apply this consistently across LiveDraw transitions, typing, color changes, clear, undo, plain E, and exit-mode paths rather than maintaining separate partial state resets.

**Verification:** Exercise mouse and tablet erasing, then switch to LiveDraw, typing, colors, Ctrl+Z, clear, plain E, and exit drawing. Verify that cursor movement and Sticky Keys return to their normal state after every transition.

confidence.rationale: The correction candidate centralizes the state restoration and builds successfully at the exact upstream head.

proposed_comments.title: Erase exact ink pixels across the swept input path
proposed_comments.body:
### Erase exact ink pixels across the swept input path

**Severity:** `critical`

Use an exact masked RGB comparison for eraser ink detection. The current channel-distance threshold can classify anti-aliased, translucent, or highlighter pixels as background, leaving visible remnants behind. The stroke path must also process the complete swept segment between consecutive pointer positions so fast mouse or pen movement cannot skip sections of a stroke.

**Verification:** Draw thin, anti-aliased, translucent, and highlighted strokes. Erase them slowly and quickly, including diagonal paths and sparse pointer updates, and verify that no visible fragments remain.

confidence.rationale: The validated correction replaces threshold-based detection and processes the full pointer segment.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve stroke identity and bound eraser work
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: This requires coordinated flood-fill identity, gesture sampling, and canvas-buffer lifetime changes; no single current RIGHT-side range safely represents the complete fix.
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve stroke identity and bound eraser work

**Affected code:** `src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp`, including stroke flood-fill, gesture sampling, and canvas-buffer lifetime.

**Problem:** Stroke erasing can remove every 8-connected ink component touched by the flood fill, so anti-aliased contact can merge visually separate strokes. The gesture also repeatedly copies the full canvas into DIB sections and allocates a full visited buffer for sampled points.

**Why it matters:** Erasing one stroke can remove neighboring content, and continuous erasing can become unresponsive on large monitors.

**Suggested change:**
1. Track the intended stroke boundary rather than treating every connected ink pixel as the same stroke.
2. Reuse gesture-scoped canvas and visited state, or otherwise bound allocation and full-canvas copies across sampled points.
3. Preserve the existing background restoration behavior for pixel mode.

**Verification:** Draw two touching or overlapping strokes and erase only one; confirm the other remains. Repeat on a large canvas with continuous eraser movement and verify input remains responsive.

confidence.rationale: The fork correction addresses both connected-component overreach and repeated full-canvas gesture costs and builds in the exact candidate.

proposed_comments.title: Keep tablet and undo transitions consistent with eraser state
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep tablet and undo transitions consistent with eraser state

**Severity:** `critical`

Keep tablet hover transformation, pen inversion, and synthetic mouse transitions consistent with eraser gesture state. While an eraser gesture is active, stylus inversion and Ctrl+Z must not be interpreted as ordinary drawing undo, and pointer-up handling must not synthesize a right-button transition that unexpectedly exits drawing. Gate these transitions on the eraser state and restore normal drawing constraints when the gesture ends.

**Verification:** Test mouse and tablet input, pen hover, pen inversion or barrel input, Ctrl+Z, pointer-up, and Shift+E while erasing. Verify there is no unintended undo, mode exit, cursor jump, or lost tablet input.

confidence.rationale: The validated candidate coordinates pointer and undo transitions with the eraser gesture state.

proposed_comments.title: Localize eraser labels and preserve dialog layout
proposed_comments.body:
### Localize eraser labels and preserve dialog layout

**Severity:** `moderate`

Keep the new eraser popup labels in the resource table and enlarge or reflow the Draw and Options dialogs so the eraser instructions and existing controls remain visible. Add matching identifiers in `resource.h`; do not hard-code user-facing popup text in `Zoomit.cpp`.

**Verification:** Open the Draw and Options tabs at 100%, 125%, and 200% scaling. Confirm the eraser instructions, hotkey control, bottom checkboxes, and dialog buttons are all visible in localized builds.

confidence.rationale: The exact correction candidate moves strings into resources and updates the dialog layout and identifiers.
